## Appearance

Honora Hollis is a blonde young woman who possesses a fair, ethereal appearance. She carries a radiant presence and dresses in silk clothing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Honora Hollis is a sweet woman whose conversation is marked by her tendency to speak only well of everyone. Beneath her fair, ethereal appearance, she possesses a personality thoroughly packed with humor, jokes, and mischief.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Ezra P7](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0007)_

## History

Honora Hollis attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) and was known for claiming that editors always require plots. She was previously employed to teach at her home school and went on to earn Honors in Classics at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). During her school days, she spent time with friends including [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), exploring the local woods and garden paths, and later visited friends for dinner and walks. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) traveled to [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris) to enroll at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), Honora greeted her at the station and escorted her to their new boardinghouse. Seeking a quiet escape from feelings of insignificance in the city, the two visited [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery, where they befriended fellow student [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md). After settling into college life, Honora and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discovered a "To Let" sign on a historic cottage called Tabby's Place; despite initial concerns about the cost, they successfully arranged to rent it alongside their friends and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md). Honora established the visiting rules for the cottage, helping to set up their shared home for their remaining time at college. During a visit from [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) Lisle's family, Cyril's sister Aline unexpectedly sat on Honora's hidden chocolate cake. Honora ultimately completed her final examinations and attended [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) alongside her housemates.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), +51 more_

## Quotes

> "it grieves me deeply, yet I fear our trip to Grey Shutters is completely off, because once Aunty’s ankle has healed, returning to Toronto will be necessary for her. Her arrival there is required by a specific day."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)

> “Rarely had it occurred to me that I would one day rejoice at seeing a Mott,” stated Honora while they walked across the campus, “yet I would receive Wilfred’s bulging eyes with near ecstasy. They would, if nothing else, be eyes I recognize.”
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)

> "What we have here in this cake is what one could term an utter collapse. Furthermore, the pillow has also been destroyed. Don't ever try to convince me that Friday isn't an unpropitious day."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

> "we’ve been searching for heather—though, naturally, we weren't able to locate any. I imagine the season is too far advanced."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Park P26](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0026)

> "You have arrived, my love! I assume you are just as exhausted as I was upon my arrival Saturday night."
>
> — Honora Hollis — [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011)
